questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All K are H.

II. No S is K.

**Conclusion:**

I. No K is S.

II. All H are K.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/596df94a972ad0fe8f6d18354340fed0ceb4e70f5e9e1c7f427f64749a6f38b9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No K is S → Follow (As no S is K. So, it is definitely true)

II. All H are K → Does not follow (As all K are H. So, it is possible but not definitely true therefore it is definitely false)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion I follows**".

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some doctors are painters.

Some doctors are labours.

All the labours are athletes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some labours are painters.

II. Some athletes are doctors.

III. All the doctors are athletes.

IV. Some athletes are painters.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbd800306216933372fd8b0bf2f46111a9303b4fb7d2e66af29cfef261363bd4.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some labours are painters → Does not follow (As some doctors are painters, some doctors are labours. So, as there is no direct relation it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some athletes are doctors → Follow (As some doctors are labours, all the labours are athletes. So, it is definitely true)

III. All the doctors are athletes → Does not follow (As some doctors are labours, all the labours are athletes. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

IV. Some athletes are painters → Does not follow (As some doctors are painters, some doctors are labours, all the labours are athletes. So, as there is no direct relation it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion II follows**".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and the fifth term is related to the sixth term.

35 ∶ 21 ∶∶ ? ∶ 36 ∶∶ 40 ∶ 24
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

**Logic : (1st number ÷ 5 ) = (2nd number ÷ 3) ** 

So, 

__
 
• 35 ∶ 21

35 ÷ 5__ = __**21 ÷ 3**__

7 = 7 (LHS = RHS)

And,

__
 
• 40 ∶ 24

40 ÷ 5__ = __24 ÷ 3__

8 = 8 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

__
 
• ? ∶ 36

x ÷ 5__ = __**36** ÷ 3__

x = __**12 × 5**__

**x = 60**

Hence, "60" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

4, 6, 12, 14, 28, 30, ?
questions.solution:
**The logic followed here is : Alternate addition of (2) and Multiplication by (2).**

⇒4 + 2 = 6

⇒6 × 2 = 12

⇒12 + 2 = 14

⇒14 × 2 = 28

⇒28 + 2 = 30

⇒30 × 2 = **60**

Hence, **"60"** is the correct answer.
